chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning’s Decapitation Strike: Nine True Gods Fall in Seconds | Desolate Era
chapter_meta_description: In a breathtaking strike, Ji Ning unleashes a perfected Karmic Punishment Deity to annihilate nine True Gods and Celestial Immortals of the Seamless Gate in a single, coordinated blitzkrieg.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0597: The Decapitation Strike
og_description: Ji Ning unleashes his perfected Karmic Punishment Deity to launch a surgical strike against three Seamless Gate lairs, killing nine True Gods.
twitter_title: Ji Ning Cleans House: Nine True Gods Slain in a Blitz
twitter_description: The Northern Sea Sword Immortal goes on the offensive, using a perfected Karmic Punishment Deity to massacre nine Seamless Gate elites in moments.

lore_anchors.definition: Colossal, headless battle avatars formed from coordinated immortal cultivator formations, representing the concentrated might of hundreds of Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals.
A powerful war formation avatar, similar to a Karmic Punishment Deity but scaled for a smaller, elite group of cultivators.
A supreme war construct possessing Daofather-level strength and extreme toughness, virtually indestructible except by a Daofather's personal effort.
A treasure born from primordial natural forces, possessing a spiritual nature; it can choose its own master and is harder to refine than manufactured treasures.
The Fiendgod Body Refining equivalent of a True Immortal, a powerful divine being whose body is virtually indestructible but whose soul remains a critical vulnerability.
A cultivator who failed their Heavenly Tribulation and is forced to live a half-life, constantly facing increasingly powerful tribulations until they are finally destroyed.
The overarching cosmic catastrophe and war between the Nuwa Alliance and the Seamless Gate that threatens the very existence of the Three Realms.
A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning kill Shaoyan Chou's avatars in secret?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He needed to eliminate the traitor's escape methods first without alerting the Seamless Gate's higher-ups, ensuring they couldn't teleport or flee before his main attack.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a Karmic Punishment Deity?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a colossal, headless war avatar formed from a coordinated formation of hundreds of Immortals, pooling their power into a single, devastating combat unit.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't the surviving True God avatars just flee?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A True God's soul is the core of their existence. If the majority of their soul is destroyed across multiple bodies, the surviving remnant cannot sustain itself and will simply collapse.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are nine True Gods such a big loss?
cultural_notes_faq.a: True Gods and Celestial Immortals are the leaders of armies. Their presence allows vast numbers of weaker Immortals to fight effectively. Killing the leaders cripples the enemy army's structure, and there are a finite number of them in the entire Three Realms.
